description: A large lobulated mass is centered on the pineal gland, engulfing the pineal calcifiation. It is somewhat hyperdense compared to adjacent brain. A further smaller mass is seen in the floor of the third ventricle. The midbrain is distorted, compressed and demonstrates low density suggestive of edema. Obstructive hydrocephalus is present.
